description: Trace of WHEN/WHERE the Vietnamese Product Page Content translation ('Cá nhân hóa QA-TEST-CTX20260921-02') appears after navigating directly to https://linh-explorer.myshopify.com/vi/products/qa-explore-campaign-pb-01. It is present in the initial HTML DOCUMENT response itself (server-side rendered by the app embed block at page-render time), not fetched via any separate client-side XHR/fetch call. No dedicated 'load translations for current locale' network request was observed anywhere in ~340 captured requests on this page load.
